NORTH﷓WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE FINANCE (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1996
NORTH‑WEST FRONTIER
PROVINCE FINANCE (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1996
An Ordinance further to amend the
North‑West Frontier Province, Finance Act, 1994
[Gazette of N.‑W.F.P.,
Extraordinary, 7th December, 1996]
No.Legis: 1(14)/73‑III,
dated 7‑12‑1995.‑‑The following Ordinance by the
Governor of the North‑West Frontier Province is hereby published for
general information:‑‑
1. Short title, extent and
commencement.‑‑(1) This Ordinance may be called the North‑West
Frontier Province Finance (Amendment) Ordinance, 1996.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 2 of N.-W.F.P.  Act I of 1994

Extraordinary, 7th December, 1996]
No.Legis: 1(14)/73‑III,
dated 7‑12‑1995.‑‑The following Ordinance by the
Governor of the North‑West Frontier Province is hereby published for
general information:‑‑
2. Amendment of section 2 of
N.‑W.F.P. Act I of 1994.‑‑In the North -West Frontier
Province Finance Act, 1994 (N.‑W.F.P. Act I of 1994), hereinafter
referred to as the said Act, in section 2,‑‑
(i) in clause (g), the word
"and" shall be added at the end; and
(ii) clause (h) shall be deleted.

(i) in subsection (1), after the
word "rates", the words and comma "specified in the Schedule,
or" shall be deleted; and
(ii) in subsection (2), the comma
and the words ",and shall be assessed on the basis of land expressed in
terms of produce index unit" shall be deleted.
